orders.description: Contains order timestamps, status (delivered, canceled), and delivery dates.

columns.order_id: Primary Key. Unique identifier for an order.
columns.order_status: Status of the order (delivered, canceled, unavailable).
columns.order_purchase_timestamp: Timestamp when the order was placed.
columns.order_approved_at: Timestamp when the order was approved.
columns.order_delivered_carrier_date: Timestamp when the order was handed to the carrier.
columns.order_delivered_customer_date: Timestamp when the order reached the customer.

order_items.description: Contains order line items, prices, seller IDs, freight costs, and discount codes.

columns.freight_value: Shipping charge associated with the item.
columns.discount_amount: Dollar value of discount subtracted from price.

products.description: Product dimensions, translated category names, and unit costs.

columns.unit_cost: Synthetic cost of manufacturing or purchasing the item.

columns.payment_type: Payment channel such as boleto, voucher, or credit_card.

order_reviews.description: Customer review scores and comments for orders.
